description: Ministry of Health - Nominating of Applicants for selection of members to the Homeopathy Medical Council
reasoning: This gazette notification pertains to the nomination and selection process for members to the Homeopathy Medical Council under the authority of the Homeopathy Act, No. 10 of 2016. The content focuses on regulatory procedures, eligibility criteria, and compliance requirements mandated by an existing law, which fits the definition of a Legal/Regulatory Gazette (Type 5). It does not involve government personnel changes, structural changes, or any of the other specialized categories like land, commercial, or public service matters.
